transcript.text: Visitors trust what other customers say more than what a site says about itself.
Trust and Social Proof has 25 elements for testimonials, logos and results.
A testimonial wall, case studies, logo clouds, ratings, counters and awards.
Add the proof you have, and the layout does the rest.
